label: Screen Swap
description: One pinned product window that swaps through feature screens while a list beside it walks the features: the active feature in full ink with a bar filling for its time on screen, the rest quiet. On a tall frame the list collapses to the active feature under the window. For 'one product, four features' tours.

screens.label: Features in order: {src, title, caption, at}

src.description: Screenshot / image URL (brand-kit screenshot, upload, capture)

title.description: Feature name, shown as the caption headline

url.description: Address shown in the browser bar

at.description: Seconds this screen takes over (default: evenly through the scene)

list_side.label: left (default) | right -- where the feature list sits

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
